headline: Computer Science Graduate | Aspiring Data and AI Engineer
summary: Recent computer science graduate seeking an entry-level role in data engineering or machine learning. Built three end-to-end projects in Python and completed online certifications in machine learning and SQL.

projects.name: Student Performance Predictor

projects.name: Expense Tracker CLI
